why: Pinterest rejects links to getaftergrow.com as spam (Tailwind failureReason blocked_spam: 'Pinterest blocked this link because it may lead to spam or inappropriate content'). The domain was registered 2026-09-30, and the block hit on the very first pin, the same pattern other brand-new claimed domains reported in Sept-Oct 2026.

appeal.who: George (needs his Pinterest login). Claude cannot file it.

canary_rule: While blocked: keep at most ONE canary pin queued at a time and at most 2 canary attempts in any 7 days. A canary is the next ready pin (queue order) that links to a different page than the last failed canary. When any canary publishes, set mode to live and release the queue.
notes: 2026-10-11: A01 failed blocked_spam at 17:35 UTC. 31 other queued posts were deleted before they could fail (one in a credit-refund test, then 30), and 2 were kept as canaries: B04 (Tue Oct 13, 6:09 PM ET) and C03 (Sat Oct 17, 1:52 PM ET). Deleting a queued post does not refund its Tailwind credit.
